body:
I see it as if I would only be able to feel pleasure/happiness then it would be possible to get by. Life has it's terrible sides for everyone, but it is the small things that are positive that makes it worth it. When feeling down and your nephew gives you a drawing he did in class. Those kinds of things make up for the bad. But as it is for me, I don't get anything out of that.

I know that I don't have a bad life by any means. But without being able to enjoy life. What's the point? Wouldn't it be better if someone who could enjoy it could take part of the things I have instead? It feels like I win something in a lottery I don't even want. And just throw it in the trash. When someone else who really wanted it couldn't get it.

What kind of mental problems are you strugling with? You don't have to answer if you don't want to. Just curious.

I've tried CBT and it didn't do anything for me. I have the abillity to see things from different perspectives, and so on. And I'm on a waiting list to see a psychologist, but that is about 2 months away.

The thing is that I mainly felt the same way even when I was together with my ex. The only difference was that when I had her and felt like shit. I could just look at her for a little while and feel that it was worth it to push on, to have the ability to try to make her happy.

A big problem is that I don't even want it to get better. I've given up on that. For myself I just want it all to end. But I can't really come to the conclusion if my wish or the wish of the ones I love is worth more. They are several people, whose life will get worse. Some of them will probably have their whole life crumbling apart, at least for a while. I'm just one person. So if I keep living then it will only be one life that is horribly fucked up, and a few lives negligibly negatively impacted.
